name: Integrated WTI Forecast
point_meaning: Median of the constructed log-return distribution; risk calibration preserves the selected price center.

source_audit.availability: Session quote + 2 US federal business days; never same-day OHLCV.
source_audit.limitation: Current-vintage unadjusted Close; verified overlap through EIA historical endpoint, not a complete point-in-time vendor archive.

base_selection_limitation: Base specifications use the full historical development window. Meta forecasts are coefficient-cross-fitted conditional on these specifications, not a fully nested unbiased historical test.
october_status: Retrospective held-out evaluation; October was inspected in prior module work. No October observations or scores select fusion parameters.

primary.loss_scale: Per-horizon RW MSE on labels public before the 2025-09-01 rule lock

primary_historical.interpretation: Paired moving-block bootstrap of origin-level losses, blocks 20 and 60; exploratory conditional historical evidence, not a fresh prospective test.
primary_historical.base_selection_limitation: Base specifications use the full historical development window. Meta forecasts are coefficient-cross-fitted conditional on these specifications, not a fully nested unbiased historical test.
